description: I'm re-siding my house myself. The east wall is only half a metre from the fence on the property line, with my neighbour's house beyond it. I want to use vinyl siding on that wall to match the rest. The city says that wall needs metal or noncombustible siding. Can I get permission for vinyl?
known_facts: house proposed for re-siding by its owner
east wall 0.5 m from the property line

missing_info.field: vinyl thickness, flame-spread result, gypsum or masonry backing, furring and existing wall rating
missing_info.why: Vinyl is not categorically prohibited: the sentence includes conditional cladding alternatives.
